name: Stat
label: Stat
description: Headline metrics with labels, trend deltas, an optional icon tile and caption, and a slot for a sparkline.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number, e.g. "~900%" or "3.8M" — or a node, such as an AnimatedNumber, for figures that move

props.name: delta
props.description: Optional change annotation, e.g. "+42% vs last quarter"

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of the delta — colours it and adds an arrow

props.name: deltaPlacement
props.description:
Where the delta sits: stacked below the label, inline to the right of the
value (bottom-aligned), or `auto`: inline while the stat has room and
stacked once it is narrow, such as a KPI tile in a two-up phone grid.
`auto` fills its parent's width and reads its own, so it restacks
wherever it sits, whatever the viewport.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative mark in a round tile above the value, naming what the metric is about: a Material Symbol name (string) or a node.

props.name: caption
props.description: A short note at the far end of the top row, in the caption face: the period the figure covers ("Last 30 days"), its source.

props.name: captionPlacement
props.description:
Where the caption sits: `head`, at the far end of the top row beside the
icon, or `label`, a second line under the label. Defaults to `head`.

props.name: children
props.description: Shown after the value, label and delta, such as a Sparkline of the metric's recent history or an AvatarGroup of who it counts.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale a number `value` is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.
